fields.why: Table 1 tests period by race/ethnicity (p<0.001) and by 3 age groups (p=0.003), and Table 2 tests vaccination status by race/ethnicity (p=0.006): rule 2 composition tests.
Race/ethnicity (6 rows) and age group (0-4, 5-11, 12-17) are the multi-level SPD margins; sex has 2 levels.

The chi-square/Fisher tests are omnibus; the headline 'largest increase among children aged 0-4 years' ranks the period RRs across the 3 age groups with no test across them, so side by side. The mechanical flag is a false alarm: the two assessments belong to different results.
